youtube.description: 大門在她身後關上。她抱著藍布包，走到老宅西邊沈記舊門面的石階下，抬頭看門楣上兩個空鐵鉤：七十八年前沈記就在這道門裡開張，她回來了；說完才在石階上坐下。林導半夜經過，開了直播「古風少女睡老店」，打賞的叮咚聲響了一夜，她以為是蟲叫，還問這筆錢該記在誰的帳上。天剛亮，知遠提著一杯豆漿蹲在她面前：藥局有間儲藏室。她搖頭：玉琴還在裡面，燈也在裡面，她得看著燈。七點半，鎖匠在大門換鎖，福伯說二太太叫人把祠堂的藥櫃抬出來了。她進了第一進的舊店堂，按住藥櫃不讓賣，說櫃子是她親手打的、底下有字。林美鳳叫工人翻過來給她死心；工人翻過櫃底，唸出「沈月棠，民國三十七年製」。林美鳳的笑僵住，建邦從工人後面走出來，盯著那一行字。

Three people: two movers in grey work clothes and gloves tilt the cabinet toward the camera, its top leaning toward the camera and its underside turned toward the door panels, the morning light through the panel gaps falling on the underside; one mover crouches between the underside and the door panels, his face hidden behind the tilted cabinet, only the top of his head and his gloves showing; Shen Yuetang stands still at the right side of the cabinet. The underside is never seen; nothing written is in the frame. The movers strain to tilt the cabinet and the drawers rattle loudly; the crouching mover leans close to the underside and freezes. A man's voice reads slowly, word by word, from behind the cabinet; no speaking mouth is visible. Shen Yuetang keeps her mouth closed.

Inside the old shop hall of the Shen house in the morning, the side panel of the tilted medicine cabinet soft and out of focus in the right foreground. Four people, none smiling: in front Lin Meifeng in her wine-red knit dress, her smile frozen on her face; behind her Shen Jianbang in his slightly worn charcoal suit and thin black-framed glasses steps out from the doorway on screen left, from behind the movers; at the right edge two movers in grey work clothes still hold the tilted cabinet, seen from the shoulders down. The corners of her mouth slowly sag; he takes one step forward, then another, his eyes fixed on the cabinet's underside, which is never seen. Both keep their mouths closed.
data.motion: Her frozen smile slowly sags while he steps forward twice from behind the movers, staring at the cabinet.
